study_design: launch-time confirmation draft with validation-only selection, frozen multi-dataset replication, AutoCon relation decomposition, and predeclared ACF falsification controls

required_before_launch: human review of the protocol and all thresholds
freeze this JSON and record its SHA256 in a launch sidecar
run dataset quality, GPU smoke, streaming equivalence, and resource gates
create immutable source and environment provenance

research_question: Does a shared Mamba-2 MambaACF forecaster using train-only signed ACF memory and AutoCon representation/relation learning match strong forecasting baselines across low- and high-dimensional data, and is any gain attributable to ACF-selected lags rather than a generic lag-memory shortcut?
claim_boundary: Any conclusion is conditional on this implementation, data contract, training budget, and frozen comparison protocol. No universal Mamba, ACF, or speed claim is permitted.

variable_token_branch.evidence: The completed ETTh1/Traffic three-seed H96 screen is directional mechanism evidence only; it does not select the confirmation architecture.
variable_token_branch.promotion_rule: A separately reviewed and hashed replication plan must be approved before any variable-token arm can enter a confirmatory table. The existing 144 selection, 740 confirmation, and 884 total counts are unchanged.

selection_contract.freeze_rule: select the AutoCon lambda with the lowest mean relative best validation MSE over all four datasets and three selection seeds; ties resolve to the smaller lambda
selection_contract.architecture_freeze: The MambaACF trunk, raw ACF source, lag-count contract, relation scope, and falsification arms are fixed before Phase A. Raw is required because the current train prior is fitted on a complete series while inference memory is formed per encoder window; residual/trend would not be numerically identical at window boundaries. Phase A selects only the AutoCon lambda; it does not select an architecture from confirmation test metrics.
selection_contract.relation_feasibility_gate: For every completed relation selection cell, mamba_acf_relation_effective_lags must be non-empty, covered by the measured train-only ACF table, and a subset of the resolved train-peak lag set; a synthetic min-lag fallback is infeasible for a peak-attribution claim. Global relation coverage and active-anchor fraction must be finite and non-zero.

confirmation_contract.test_read_gate: Selection never reads test. Frozen confirmation commands may generate immutable test artifacts job by job; humans and analysis scripts must not aggregate or use them for any remaining decision until every registered confirmation phase passes strict validation and the selection sidecar is attested.
confirmation_contract.independence_note: Forecast windows and channels are not independent replicates; only seed-level paired contrasts enter inferential summaries.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms use the same sequence split, features, maximum epochs, early-stopping patience, optimizer family, regularization, scheduler, batch contract, and registered d_model/d_ff/depth values unless an architecture has no such field.
capacity_fairness_contract.capacity_matched_architecture_comparator: Mamba2 at the same nominal Mamba width and depth is the capacity-matched architecture comparator for MambaACF.
capacity_fairness_contract.prelaunch_audit: Before launch, use scripts/benchmark_model_resources.py in parameter-audit mode for every dataset at H96. Record total and active trainable parameter counts, then verify max(MambaACFAutoCon_active / Mamba2_active, reciprocal) <= 1.5 for ETTh1, ETTh2, Electricity, and Traffic.
capacity_fairness_contract.failure_action: If the Mamba2 capacity-ratio gate fails for any dataset, this plan cannot claim a capacity-matched Mamba comparison. Revise width/depth under a new plan hash and restart selection.
capacity_fairness_contract.external_baseline_boundary: PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, DLinear, and NLinear are mandatory fixed-budget accuracy baselines, but are not declared parameter-matched. Report their total and active counts; do not attribute an unmatched difference solely to the Mamba operator.

arms.acf_off: MambaACF with all ACF-dependent forecast branches disabled
arms.acf_peak_memory: MambaACF with train-only availability-weighted ACF peak memory
arms.acf_fixed_placebo: MambaACF with causal memory at fixed lags [5, 11, 17] independent of train-peak ranking; descriptive falsification only because its horizon-availability profile is not matched to the peak arm
arms.autocon_relation: MambaACFAutoCon with global signed ACF relation loss and no forecast memory
arms.autocon_memory_relation: MambaACFAutoCon with availability-weighted memory plus global signed ACF relation loss
arms.soft_relation_sensitivity: H96-only sensitivity arm using soft_multi_peak; not eligible to define the primary method

accuracy_claim_contract.boundary: The registered primary statistical gate supports an accuracy non-inferiority claim only against PatchTST and Mamba2. The other named baselines remain mandatory rows for descriptive context and cannot be folded into a stronger all-baseline claim without a new reviewed statistical family.

acf_falsification_contract.effective_lag_cardinality_gate: The resolved peak arm and fixed placebo must expose the same number of effective memory lags per dataset and horizon; this cardinality check does not establish availability equivalence.
acf_falsification_contract.availability_profile_warning: With seq_len=96 and horizon=96, fixed lags [5,11,17] expose only 5.2%, 11.5%, and 17.7% of forecast steps, whereas availability-weighted peak lags can cover most or all steps. Therefore this arm cannot support a peak-selection attribution or a generic-memory superiority claim.
acf_falsification_contract.future_matched_sham_requirement: Before a future plan can promote peak-versus-placebo attribution, implement and unit-test a predeclared non-peak lag matcher that minimizes the horizon-level legal-availability profile difference while preserving lag cardinality; freeze its algorithm and tolerance in a new plan hash.

interpretation.peak_vs_off: If peak memory is not non-inferior to ACF-off under the registered margin, do not claim an ACF forecasting benefit.
interpretation.peak_vs_placebo: Descriptive only: because the fixed-lag availability profile is unmatched, this contrast cannot distinguish peak selection from generic lag availability and is excluded from the primary statistical gate.
interpretation.relation_increment: If memory plus relation is inferior to memory-only, report that AutoCon relation supervision adds no confirmed accuracy value for this contract.
interpretation.true_sham_limit: The fixed-lag placebo is neither an availability-matched nor a sign-shuffled/channel-permuted ACF null. A stronger sham requires a separately implemented and reviewed model option; it is not silently inferred here.

statistical_gate.paired_effect: seed-level log(MSE_treatment / MSE_reference) and raw MSE delta
statistical_gate.interval_construction_rule: For each named comparison, use a one-sided paired Student-t upper confidence bound on seed-level log(MSE_treatment / MSE_reference) with per-cell alpha = 0.05 / 12 (Bonferroni adjusted-alpha simultaneous family). This is not an inversion of Holm step-down tests.
statistical_gate.multiplicity: Use the fixed Bonferroni adjusted-alpha rule for simultaneous interval bounds across the 12 dataset-horizon cells of each named comparison. Separately report Holm-adjusted one-sided paired-t p-values; BH-FDR is sensitivity only.
statistical_gate.current_analyzer_capabilities: scripts/analyze_mamba_acf_confirmation.py requires every registered test-producing confirmation phase, verifies plan/manifest/provenance/source/artifact hashes, selection-copy/binding hashes and exact coordinates, and emits one-sided log-MSE Bonferroni bounds, frozen numeric non-inferiority/superiority gate results, Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values, exact Wilcoxon signed-rank sensitivity, and seed/cell coverage for the four primary named contrasts. The fixed-placebo phase remains available for descriptive diagnostics but is not aggregated as a primary contrast. scripts/compute_paper_statistics.py remains a separate legacy raw-delta analyzer.
statistical_gate.analyzer_requirement: The analyzer implementation and unit tests are present and included in SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_PATHS. Before any confirmatory claim, a human must review the Bonferroni interval construction, explicit phase:model contrast mapping, small-sample Wilcoxon convention, and launch-sidecar source/test hashes. No confirmation result is present in this repository.

noninferiority_margin.interpretation: Bonferroni upper log-ratio bound <= log_threshold is required for the planned 1 percent multiplicative MSE non-inferiority margin; this computational gate remains unreviewed until an authorized confirmation launch completes.

superiority_threshold.interpretation: Bonferroni upper log-ratio bound < log_threshold is required for superiority; this computational gate remains unreviewed until an authorized confirmation launch completes.

statistical_gate.incomplete_cell_rule: Any missing or invalid seed in a claimed cell blocks confirmatory aggregation for that cell and prevents a universal headline.
statistical_gate.small_n_warning: Five seeds support paired uncertainty reporting but remain a modest sample; p-values are not evidence of equivalence and null results remain inconclusive.

resource_contract.when: after Phase A freeze and before final test interpretation
resource_contract.timing: at least 50 warm-up and 200 timed device-resident iterations; report median and p90 over three repeats
reported: peak allocated and reserved GPU memory
resource_contract.efficiency_claim_gate: Only claim a speed advantage when the accuracy non-inferiority gate passes and median end-to-end epoch time is at least 10 percent lower than the named nonlinear comparator in every claimed cell.
resource_contract.linear_baseline_boundary: Do not claim that a nonlinear Mamba model is faster than DLinear or NLinear.
